phone.description: The Test number, in E.164 format.

online.description: True while the simulated phone is running.

devices.description: Companions linked to the phone, such as Polymorfa's own session and Inspector.

request_id.description: Matches the X-Request-Id response header. Include it when you contact support.

request_log_url.description: Console page that shows this request. Returned only to organization and project credentials whose request was logged.

data.description: Always null for a failed request.

to.description: Another Test number in the same project, in E.164 format.

event.description: Fixture name. Each name is the event type it produces.

fromNumber.description: message.received only. Send a simulated text message from this other connected Test number in the same project instead of generating an event.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Team request quota per rolling minute, when the per-team request limiter applies.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the per-team quota; zero when this limiter rejects the request.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the oldest counted request leaves the rolling window, when the per-team request limiter applies. Follow Retry-After on a rejected request.
